q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of an aluminium window per square metre?
title: Aluminium window carbon footprint per sq m
short: The aluminium section is most of an aluminium window: weigh the profiles per square metre and use the extruder's per-kg figure. Add glass, gaskets and hardware, then the shop's cutting and assembly energy divided by area made.

ul: Extruded aluminium profiles, powder coated or anodised.

p: Report per square metre by system. Ask the extruder whether the billet is primary or contains recycled metal.

example.title: Worked example: aluminium window unit per sq m (one month)
lines: Plant total: 4,260 / 2,000 = 2.130 kg CO2 per sq m
Add aluminium profiles and glass for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
